title: New Open Secure AI Alliance Aims for AI Safety and Security
description: Industry leaders including Nvidia, SpaceX, and Microsoft have formed the Open Secure AI Alliance to focus on AI safety and security.

sections.heading: Open Secure AI Alliance Formation
paragraphs: The Open Secure AI Alliance has been established with the goal of ensuring AI safety and security, according to the NVIDIA Blog.

sections.heading: Alliance Members
paragraphs: Key industry players such as Nvidia, SpaceX, and Microsoft are part of this initiative, as reported by CNBC.

sections.heading: Context and Background
paragraphs: The formation of the alliance comes amidst ongoing concerns about AI safety, following a recent cyberattack on OpenAI as noted by CNBC.

faq.q: What is the Open Secure AI Alliance?
faq.a: The Open Secure AI Alliance is an initiative formed by industry leaders to focus on AI safety and security, as mentioned by the NVIDIA Blog.

faq.q: Which companies are part of the alliance?
faq.a: Nvidia, SpaceX, and Microsoft are among the companies that have joined the Open Secure AI Alliance, according to CNBC.
